audit.why: All three sources agree: the packet levelChart, the content win[] and the full phases[].side all read LeBlanc for every stage, and 53.21% over 3665 games supports it. Lux has no dash and her only lockdown is a flat 10s projectile, so no row moves. Ratings left at 8/10 falling to 7/10 late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike credited Lux with 'Mercury Cannon' damage. That is not a Lux ability at all. Her ultimate is Final Spark, 3340 range on 60/50/40 seconds.
audit.why: Enemy kit R: Final Spark. No ability named Mercury Cannon exists in her kit.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten around Final Spark's real range and 60-second rank-1 cooldown, which is the actual reason the window exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illumination was never mentioned. Lux's spells charge the target and her NEXT AUTO-ATTACK detonates the charge for bonus magic damage, so roughly half her poke arrives on an auto rather than a spell — and Final Spark refreshes the debuff. The page treated her as pure skillshots.
audit.why: Enemy passive text; missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell.
audit.corrected: mid now tells you to watch the auto as the second half of her damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard cooldown errors. mid claimed 'her 4-5 second Binding cooldown' and dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a whiffed Light Binding. Light Binding is a flat 10 seconds at every rank. breakdown.cooldowns also contained no digit at all.
audit.corrected: Both numbers corrected to 10s, and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Q, W, E and R cooldowns plus the consequence that her shield is up more often than her root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eight fields called Lux he/his; two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; 'Binding' was used as the ability name in three places where Riot's name is Light Binding — the packet flagged wants.foe[0] for exactly this.
audit.why: Lux is she/her; enemy Q is Light Binding; lintFindings and packet suspectNames name each field.
audit.corrected: All regendered, both bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded bodies, and the ability name completed in wants.foe[0], whys[2], spikes[1] and mid.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank and costs 50 mana: when it is gone she has no way to stop you for ten seconds. - Lucent Singularity is 10s down to 8s and Prismatic Barrier is 12s, so the shield is up more often than the root. - Final Spark is 60s at rank 1.

edits.before: At 6 you gain full combo burst (W-Q-Sigil-R) that can one-shot her from nearly 700 range if she's caught without Binding up, and her Final Spark, while huge damage, requires she land Binding first or hard-commit blind — something good LeBlancs simply never allow. Bait her CC with the clone, then all-in the real body the instant it's spent; her 4-5 second Binding cooldown is a long window you can freely roam or shove during. Only respect her ult range if she's already landed a root — otherwise you're the one initiating every skirmish.
edits.after: At 6 your full combo (W-Q-Sigil-R) one-shots her from nearly 700 range if she is caught without Light Binding up, and her Final Spark reaches 3340 but wants the root to land first — something you never allow. Bait the root with the clone, then all-in the real body the instant it is spent; Light Binding is a flat 10 seconds at every rank, and that is a long window to roam or shove in. Watch her autos too: Illumination charges on every spell she lands and her next attack detonates it, so the auto is the second half of her damage.

notes: No chart edits: packet, full and content all already agreed on LeBlanc for all seven rows. Two real cooldown fabrications were fixed — 'her 4-5 second Binding cooldown' and a 'fifteen-second invitation' — against Light Binding's actual flat 10s. 'Mercury Cannon' is a Jayce ability and appeared in Lux's level 6 spike. The kit tags Lucent Singularity with a revealsStealth flag, but Riot's description only mentions the slow, so I wrote the slow and not the reveal.
